# redesign

On-demand reference adapted from the vendored MIT UI/UX Kit. Project policy
and frontend-design govern scope and completion.

Use only when the request includes redesign. Inspect incumbent behavior,
content, hierarchy, and documented decisions. Define the requested scope and
preserve everything outside it. Improve the real app, then verify relevant
workflows, accessibility, desktop/mobile layout, and scrolling.
A redesign does not automatically include every page.
